title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a syringe experiment photo guide to Session 1
body:
## Problem
Session 1 describes a two-syringe experiment but has no pictures or measured numbers.

## Context
A hands-on check helps students trust the model.

## Expected outcome
A short guide with a photo or sketch, the measured bore diameters and the measured force ratio next to the predicted ratio.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Predicted and measured force ratio shown
- [ ] A sentence on why they differ

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: pump strokes with check valves
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4. The shipped lift model has a continuous pump flow and no check valve, so the car cannot hold its height when the pump stops.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: air in the oil
body:
## Problem
Session 3 uses one fixed bulk modulus; trapped air makes it much lower.

## Context
Roadmap Session 5.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app with a pump dead volume and an effective bulk modulus, showing the extra pumps per centimetre.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-02/lesson.py`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Roadmap checkpoint met (at least 1.7 pumps per cm)
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: a pumping jack with a force-speed curve
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a pumping jack with valves, a gauge and a force-speed trade-off curve; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The ram rises in steps and holds between strokes
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Add a viscosity-versus-temperature table for common oils
body:
## Problem
Session 3 uses one rough fit for how oil thins when warm.

## Context
Students should see where the 0.0318 per degree comes from and how it differs between oils.

## Expected outcome
A documented table from published data sheets and a function that interpolates it.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Sources named
- [ ] Checkpoint compares the table with the shipped fit

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
